description: This file contains an abstract Java class 'BaseCustomizableData' that extends 'BaseChangeableOpenmrsData' and implements 'Customizable' interface parameterized with attribute type A. It provides methods for managing user-defined attributes, including adding, setting, and retrieving active attributes, supporting customization features within the OpenMRS healthcare platform.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableData
classes.description: An abstract class that supports user-defined attribute customization for entities within OpenMRS, allowing addition, retrieval, and management of attributes, with support for voiding and attribute type filtering.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of all attributes associated with the object.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the entire collection of attributes for the object.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns a collection of active (non-voided) attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns a list of active attributes filtered by the specified attribute type descriptor.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the attribute set and sets its owner to this object.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Voids existing attributes of the same type and sets a new attribute, handling max occurrences.
